description: Earnings dates from the companies' own 8-Ks (Item 2.02, results of operations). For a company: its recent results releases with the quarter each covered and whether it came before the open or after the close (EDGAR's acceptance time), and the next release estimated from the same quarter a year earlier, with a window. Across the market: who is due to report in a window, from when they reported in the same weeks last year, marked once they have. Estimates, not announcements.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name: its results releases and the next one estimated. Leave out for the market.

limit.description: Across the market: most companies to list (the largest first); default 100.

quarters.description: Past releases to list for a company; default 8.

since.description: Across the market: first day of the window; default today.

until.description: Across the market: last day; default 14 days after since, at most 31.

name: earnings_calendar

outputSchema.description: For a company: next is the estimated next release (expected, earliest, latest, basis, status) and releases is a table, newest first. Across the market: rows are companies in the order of columns.

title: Earnings calendar
